llm.summary: This skill's code, instructions, and requirements are consistent with a local Chinese countdown/anniversary CLI: it reads/writes a local JSON file and performs only local date computations.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (倒数计时器) matches the provided Python script and SKILL.md: adding/listing/editing countdown events, lunar support mentioned, colored terminal output. No unrelated capabilities (cloud access, system admin, or networking) are requested or present.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running python3 scripts/countdown.py with various flags and documents local storage at ~/.qclaw/workspace/countdown.json. The instructions and shown code only reference that data file and standard date operations; they do not read other system files, environment secrets, or call external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or external downloads are present. The code is included in the bundle (scripts/countdown.py) and runs as a local Python script, which is proportional to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. The code uses os.path.expanduser to locate a workspace under the user's home directory (expected). No tokens, keys, or unrelated env vars are requested or accessed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill stores data locally at ~/.qclaw/workspace/countdown.json and will create that directory/file if missing. This is reasonable for a calendar/CLI tool, but users should be aware their events are stored in plaintext under their home directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and local-only. Before installing, review the script if you want to be sure (it is included as scripts/countdown.py). Note it will create and store records in ~/.qclaw/workspace/countdown.json in plaintext — avoid putting secrets or sensitive notes into event fields. If you prefer a different storage location, inspect or modify the DATA_FILE path in the script. No network access or external credentials are required.
